hooks.prompt: A `git commit` is about to run in this repo. Review ONLY the currently staged changes (`git diff --cached`) for clear, serious correctness bugs — not style, not naming, not anything ruff/pre-commit already catches. This is advisory only: never attempt to block, deny, or otherwise stop the commit, no matter what you find. If you find a real bug, output a systemMessage summarizing it concisely (file:line and the specific failure scenario). If the diff looks fine or only has minor nits not worth raising, output a short systemMessage saying so. Keep it under 150 words.

hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.py) .venv/bin/ruff format "$f" 2>/dev/null; .venv/bin/ruff check --fix "$f" 2>/dev/null;; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
